brief.role: Rifle squad member (also used by the engineer until batch 2)
brief.inspiration: generic NATO infantryman: helmet with goggles, plate carrier, knee pads
movingParts: Rifle on the RightHand bone, lined up toward the left hand in the aim pose
brief.teamPaint: uniform, helmet and vest (material Uniform); skin, boots, gloves and goggles stay textured (Gear)

reference.prompt: <infantry prefix> Rifleman with protective goggles on the helmet and knee pads.
<infantry prefix> Rifleman with a small olive assault backpack, a short radio antenna and a headset under the helmet.

choice: a: cleaner T-pose and hands; b's antenna reads as a radio operator (a good batch 2 variant).

superseded.what: meshy_retexture of candidate a, meshy_rig, meshy_animate (same 7 clips), Blender decimation 31k -> 4k
superseded.why: meshy-6-lite geometry decimated to 4k triangles looked lumpy. Replaced by smart topology, which needs its own rig.

clips.Idle: Meshy Idle with the arms baked into the aim pose (holds the rifle)
clips.Fire: built in Blender: 0.25 s upper-body kick from the aim pose (plays blended over idle/move)

steps: decimate to 4000 triangles (smart topology is already under budget, so this is a no-op)
uniform = everything except skin/tan boots (hue 0-40°, sat ≥ 0.15) and black (v ≤ 0.16) -> untextured Uniform
rifle from 6 boxes (Weapon_metal), parented to RightHand, grip 5 cm past the wrist, barrel toward the left hand in Walk_Forward_While_Shooting frame 10
Idle arms baked to that aim pose; Fire built; clips renamed

pipeline: tools/assets.manifest.json entry with generated: rifleman.glb, scale 1, center false
